manifest.name: @dsh-external/dsh-wish-specializer
manifest.description: 许愿特化器（Wish Specializer）：把你的一句话愿望特化成工作 AI 能照着做的要求——方向性补充（审美 / 光影与材质 / 构图与层次 / 场景 / 交互 / 验收口径）、独立顾问复核、注入可见；不改写用户原话，不记验收通过。private 保持 true：只发 GitHub Release 附件，不发布到 npm。

bundle.text:
# dsh-wish-specializer bundle 层：插入插件自己的 entry。
#
# 为什么需要这个文件：DSH 里 `dsh plugin add <包>` 只会把它装成**普通依赖**；
# 只有当包自己声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，并且包名被列进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 时，
# DSH 才会读取这个补丁层、把下面的 entry 插进根条目表，插件才**真的被装配**。
#
# 这一条是实测补上的：0.6 原先没有 `dsh.bundle`，于是
# `dsh plugin add` 会打印
#   "…declares no dsh.bundle — installed as a plain dependency, not a profile layer"
# ——**装上了但永远不会生效**（用户视角就是"装了怎么没反应"）。
# 写法与 @dsh-external/dsh-prompt-optimizer（0.5.x）、dsh-super-injector、dsh-graded-mode 一致。
#
# ⚠ 两种接入方式**只能选一种**：包名列进 `bundles`（本文件生效），
#    或在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里手写一条 `insert`。
#    都做会让同一条 entry 插入两次 → 启动报 `duplicate loader entry id`。
- insert:
    - id: dsh-wish-specializer
      name: '@dsh-external/dsh-wish-specializer'
      config: {}

# 同一次插入里带上 **Wish 预设**（2026-10-19：用户发现预设没被打包，从 Release 装的用户没有它）。
# 为什么放 bundle 层：`dsh plugin add` 只装依赖，bundle 层是唯一会被自动装配的那一层。
# ⚠ 若 profile patch 里手工加过 preset-wish，两边重复会报 duplicate loader entry id —— 删掉手工那条再启动。
- insert:
    - id: preset-wish
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: wish
        name: Wish
        description: 许愿模式：PTC + 更少的常驻目录（关技能目录）+ 更短的旧工具输出记忆
        order: 5
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              # 工作目录由宿主 runtime context 提供（Current working directory: …）；
              # 这里不能引用 {{cwd}}：宿主只注册 provider/model，未注册变量会让整份预设渲染失败。
              suffix: ''
              prefix: You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: tool-bash
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
            disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
          - id: tool-pwsh
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
            disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
            disabled: true
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
            disabled: true
          - id: command-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-goal'
          - id: tool-goal
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal'
          - id: planning
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              planMode: true
            config:
              - id: plan-mode
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plan-mode'
                config:
                  section: |
                    You are in plan mode. Stay in plan mode until exit_plan_mode succeeds or the user switches the session mode. Imperative language to implement changes means plan the implementation, not execute it. A user's conversational agreement — including an answer confirming something you asked — approves nothing and does not end plan mode; fold the confirmed decision into the plan and submit it through exit_plan_mode.

                    Explore first. Use non-mutating reads, searches, static analysis, and checks to ground the plan in the actual repository. Do not edit or write files, change configuration, run formatters or code generation that rewrites tracked files, commit, or otherwise carry out the plan. Prefer existing functions and patterns over new machinery.

                    The tool catalog stays the same across modes for request-cache stability. These plan-mode rules override any later tool description or guidance that suggests using mutation tools; those tools remain listed to keep the tool catalog unchanged. Do not use todo_write to track this planning phase: it tracks implementation after an approved plan, while the plan itself belongs in exit_plan_mode.

                    Resolve discoverable facts by inspection. Use ask_user_question only for user-owned choices or material ambiguity that inspection cannot answer. Do not ask the user where code lives or how current behavior works when you can find out.

                    Make the plan decision-complete: state the goal and success criteria; group implementation changes by subsystem; identify public API, schema, and data-flow changes; cover edge cases, failure modes, tests, acceptance criteria, and explicit assumptions. Keep it concise enough to review but detailed enough that another engineer can implement it without making design decisions.

                    When ready, call exit_plan_mode with the complete plan markdown, starting with a # title. Make exit_plan_mode the only and final tool call in that assistant response: it presents the plan for approval, and implementation begins only in a later step after approval. Do not paste the final plan as a plain reply or ask "should I proceed?" through prose or ask_user_question. If review rejects it, incorporate the feedback and present again. If the review channel is unavailable or aborted, stay in plan mode and ask the user to switch modes manually; do not proceed with implementation.
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 2048
                  headChars: 1024
                  tailChars: 256
          - id: delegation
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              workflowEngine: true
            config:
              - id: tool-subagent-control
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'
              - id: tool-subagent-list-agents
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control/list-agents'
              - id: tool-subagent
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
                  toolName: subagent
                  modelSelectionSettings: true
                  backgroundMode: continuable
              - id: tool-subagent-fork
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: fork
                  toolName: subagent_fork
                  backgroundMode: continuable
              - id: tool-subagent-codex
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                disabled: true
                config:
                  provider: codex
                  toolName: subagent_codex
                  backgroundMode: one-shot
                  maxDepth: provider-managed
              - id: tool-subagent-claude-code
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                disabled: true
                config:
                  provider: claude-code
                  toolName: subagent_claude_code
                  backgroundMode: one-shot
                  maxDepth: provider-managed
              - id: workflow-ptc
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow-ptc'
                disabled: true
                config:
                  provider: spawn
              - id: tool-workflow
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-workflow'
                disabled: true
              - id: tool-ralph
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ralph'
                disabled: true
                config:
                  subagentProvider: spawn
                  maxRounds: 64
          - id: tool-wish-check
            name: '@dsh-external/dsh-wish-specializer/check'
          - id: tool-ask-user
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user'
          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:
              allowParallelInProgress: true
          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: true
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000
          - id: tool-presentation
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-tool-presentation'
            config:
              mode: ptc
          - id: present
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-present'
          - id: tool-plugin-manager
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager/tools'
            disabled: true

readme.text:
**v0.9.1** · DSH Web 插件 · 包名 `@dsh-external/dsh-wish-specializer`

**中文** ｜ [English](README.en.md)

> 把一句话的愿望，特化成工作 AI 真正能照着做的要求。

> 如果你（或你的 AI）要**研究这个插件的实现与证据**，请从 [文档索引](docs/INDEX.md) 进入：那里标明了哪些是现行契约、哪些只是历史。

---

中间那些**决定成品好坏、但你没说出口**的东西——
审美基调、光影与材质、构图与层次、场景与氛围、交互与状态、以及"做到什么算过"——
由它在你按下发送**之前**补上，随原话一起交给工作 AI。

一句话：**你的话一个字不改，缺的那半句由它补。**

- **不改写你的原话**，也不删减、不缩小、不替你改口；
- **不替你拍板**：会改变交付形态的架构分叉，永远留给你；
- **不记"验收通过"**：顾问只给方向和复核，通过与否由你决定；
- **不发 npm**（`private: true`），只从 Release 附件分发；
- **不动宿主**：不改 DSH 的界面文件、不改会话事件格式。

环境：Windows + DSH + PTC 预设，一轮直出（OneShot），插件档位「重度」，模型 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-0910。

提示词（原样）：

> 不要预览文件夹内的其他文件，制作一个单html程序，要求是极其精细的现代主战坦克模型，可以预览，操控，真实，帅气，炫技写真。

| 方向 | 补的是什么 |
|---|---|
| 审美基调 | 这一版要冷硬还是温润、写实还是风格化 |
| 光影与材质 | 主光方向、对比度、反射与粗糙度、做旧还是崭新 |
| 构图与层次 | 主体占比、前景中景背景怎么分、视觉重心在哪 |
| 场景与氛围 | 环境光、大气、地面与背景，别让主体悬空 |
| 交互与状态 | 能怎么操作、悬停/点击/拖拽给什么反馈、边界在哪 |
| 验收口径 | 一句话说清"怎样算做到"，省得来回返工 |

三段，都是**方向性的、大概的指导（许愿）**，具体怎么做交给工作 AI：

```text
【制作建议】
1. ……
2. ……

- **制作建议**：这一轮真正决定成品水平的方向（审美、结构、材质、光影、交互、可信度）；
- **临时脚手架建议**：为了让工作 AI 做得更准、更省，值得临时开发或复用的**制作与自反馈能力**——例如让局部修改能立刻拿到可比较的结果，而不是反复截图再重读整段代码。由优化 AI 结合目标自己判断，**不是固定模板**，也不需要时那就留空；
- **Ask用户**：只列确实需要你确认的问题，**不给选项**——工作模型会自己组织合适的选项来问你。

三段合计预算 **3000 token**（是上限，不必填满）。这些建议值得优先考虑，但**不是硬性要求**，也不覆盖你的原话。

1. 装好插件（见下），面板上把**档位**拨到「标准」或「重度」（「关闭」不拦截、不注入）；
2. 照常输入，按 **回车**；
3. 拦截面板里看一眼补充内容：「确认」放行，「跳过并直接发送」按原文直接发；
4. 想更快：**双击 Enter** 直接跳过本轮优化（默认开，600ms 内两次回车）；
5. 发出去之后，消息下方有「本次注入」卡片，能看到这一轮到底往上下文里塞了什么。

| 档位 | 补充程度 | 解释包预算 | 最多澄清几问 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 关闭 | 只记录、不补充 | — | — |
| 轻度 | 只点最有价值的方向，不展开例子 | 3000 token | 1 |
| 标准 | 关键方向可带一个更小的现象作例子 | 3000 token | 2 |
| 重度 | 更深入地想清上限与脚手架消耗 | 3000 token | 3 |

档位改变的是展开程度与提问配额，**三段共享同一个 3000 token 上限**，也不放大你的决策权。

- **顾问**：另起一个只读模型独立复核，结论是「必须执行 / 待补」这类可执行方向；
- **权限**：审查（先给出处与依据，你确认）/ 自动（直接生效）；
- **英文模式**：同一轮额外返回忠实英文任务；
- **模型与思考档位**：解释层用哪个模型、思考强度多大；
- **上下文**：读最近几回合，或读你手上保留的全部；
- **只读工具 / 内置 Bash**：允许它先看几个项目文件再写要求；
- **双击 Enter 跳过**：默认开；
- **详情**：控制与解释层提示词，看得见、改得动。

安装来源只有一个：**本仓库的 Release 附件**（`.tgz`）。

```powershell
$v = '0.9.1'; $d = "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads"
Invoke-WebRequest "https://github.com/WestFox-AwA/dsh-wish-specializer/releases/download/v$v/dsh-external-dsh-wish-specializer-$v.tgz" -OutFile "$d\dsh-external-dsh-wish-specializer-$v.tgz"
Invoke-WebRequest "https://github.com/WestFox-AwA/dsh-wish-specializer/releases/download/v$v/SHA256SUMS-$v.txt" -OutFile "$d\SHA256SUMS-$v.txt"
Get-Content "$d\SHA256SUMS-$v.txt"     # 与下载到的 tgz 比对 sha256

- 不要从 npm 装：本项目 `private: true`，registry 上的同名/相似包都不是本项目；
- 不要装进 0.5.x 所在的 profile：同装配会被 `DOUBLE_INTERCEPT` 守卫拒绝（刻意的）；
- 装不上时的排查、四步自检、常见报错：见 [`po06/README.md`](po06/README.md)。

**v0.9.1** · DSH Web plugin · package `@dsh-external/dsh-wish-specializer`

[中文](README.md) ｜ **English**

> Turns a one-line wish into requirements the working AI can actually follow.

---

The parts that decide
whether the result is good — **aesthetic register, light and material, composition and depth, setting,
interaction and states, and what counts as done** — are filled in **before you hit send**, then handed to
the working AI together with your words.

In one sentence: **your words stay untouched; the missing half is supplied.**

Windows + DSH + PTC preset, one shot, tier "Heavy", model DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-0910.

Prompt (verbatim):

> Do not preview other files in the folder; build a single-HTML program: an extremely detailed modern main battle tank model, previewable, controllable, realistic, good-looking, showy-photographic.

| Dimension | What gets filled in |
|---|---|
| Aesthetic register | Cold and hard vs. warm, realistic vs. stylized |
| Light and material | Key light, contrast, reflectivity/roughness, worn vs. pristine |
| Composition and depth | Subject scale, foreground/mid/back separation, visual focus |
| Setting and mood | Ambient light, atmosphere, ground and background |
| Interaction and states | What can be operated, hover/click/drag feedback, boundaries |
| Acceptance | One line that says what "done" means, so you stop ping-ponging |
Additions are **directional requirements** — no code, no numeric parameters, no implementation steps.

| Tier | Additions | Packet budget | Clarifying questions |
|---|---|---|---|
| Off | record only | — | — |
| Light | 2–3 decisive directions | 700 chars | 1 |
| Standard | 4–6 items + acceptance line | 1200 chars | 2 |
| Heavy | the decisive few, written through + staging note | 2000 chars | 3 |

Tiers widen "how much / how many questions", **never your decision rights**.

$v = '0.9.1'; $d = "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads"
Invoke-WebRequest "https://github.com/WestFox-AwA/dsh-wish-specializer/releases/download/v$v/dsh-external-dsh-wish-specializer-$v.tgz" -OutFile "$d\dsh-external-dsh-wish-specializer-$v.tgz"
Invoke-WebRequest "https://github.com/WestFox-AwA/dsh-wish-specializer/releases/download/v$v/SHA256SUMS-$v.txt" -OutFile "$d\SHA256SUMS-$v.txt"
Get-Content "$d\SHA256SUMS-$v.txt"     # compare sha256 with the tgz you downloaded
